RSSB Computer Instructor Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the answer key for the post of Computer Instructor on the official website of RSSB. This recruitment has been issued for 3951 posts. Online applying process for RSSB Computer Instructor Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 25 May 2026 to 23 June 2026. The exam is was held on 22 & 23 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for RSSB Computer Instructor Answer Key 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 22 May 2026
  • Application Start Date : 25 May 2026
  • Last Date : 23 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 26 June 2026
  • Exam Date (Senior Instructor) : 22 August 2026
  • Exam Date (Basic Instructor) : 23 August 2026
  • Exam City Details : 14 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 19 August 2026
  • Answer Key : 18 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS , OBC (Non Creamy Layer), EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
